parts.title: Sculpted riser
parts.description: Original unbranded riser with open truss geometry. A visual study, not a measured replica.

parts.title: Walnut grip
parts.description: The grip locates the bow hand. This model does not prescribe grip pressure or hand position.

parts.title: Recurved limbs
parts.description: Tapered composite limbs. Shown braced at rest; there is no simulated draw-weight or flex measurement.

parts.title: String and serving
parts.description: Upper and lower string contacts with a served centre. No release or dry-fire animation.

parts.title: Recurve sight
parts.description: Extension, elevation rail and open sight ring. Decorative positions are not sight marks.

parts.title: Stabilisation system
parts.description: Long rod, V-bar, side rods and dampers, separated for inspection. Not a recommended weight setup.

parts.title: Rest, button and clicker
parts.description: Distinct small components beside the sight window. Visual identification only.

parts.title: Limb pockets and hardware
parts.description: Limb pockets, adjustment heads and fasteners are modelled separately.

parts.title: Carbon shaft
parts.description: A slender carbon target-arrow study. Spine, length and mass are not fitted to the athlete.

parts.title: Target point
parts.description: Rounded target-point profile, shown separately for identification. Not a broadhead.

parts.title: Slotted nock
parts.description: A visible string slot in a separate polymer nock; not a solid cone.

parts.title: Three fletching vanes
parts.description: Three individually modelled thin vanes at 120-degree spacing.

parts.title: Wrap and identification bands
parts.description: Unbranded wrap and collars. No invented spine specifications.

parts.title: Ten-ring target face
parts.description: Ten concentric scoring rings with the inner-X guide. This is an equipment illustration, not the scoring engine.

parts.title: Compressed target butt
parts.description: A layered cylindrical practice butt, with restrained fibre texture.

parts.title: Timber stand
parts.description: Three supports, cross brace and retaining ledge. Visualization only, not a construction plan.

parts.title: Face retainers
parts.description: Four visible paper retainers near the outer edge.
